PermissionTemplateParameterDeclaration.description: A template parameter declared by a customer managed permission's policy template. The name is used as the placeholder in the policy template using the syntax @{parameterName}.

Type.description: The type of the template parameter. STRING substitutes a single string value directly into the template; STRING_LIST expands one or more string values to an array in the rendered policy.
